mechanism.claim: A strict 24-hour range escape observed only after a canonical six-block confirmation and conservative header-time embargo identifies persistent volatile price discovery; follow the escape direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: +1 above the frozen prior-24h high, -1 below the frozen prior-24h low
mechanism.why_distinct: CCRE uses no ladder return path, block payload, flow, funding, premium, OI, fitted threshold, or prior rank. Canonical blocks provide only an asynchronous causal observation clock; the signal is a strict completed-bar range escape.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: new 24-hour extremes sampled on an irregular confirmation clock target directional volatility expansion; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: height-modulo confirmation anchors, strict range escapes, and six-hour reservation create a sparse asynchronous clock

features.anchor: canonical height H divisible by 36; confirmation is block H+6
features.raw_availability: prefix maximum header timestamp and mediantime through H+6 plus 7200 seconds
features.decision: raw availability ceiled to exact five-minute UTC boundary D
features.signal_bar: the exact completed BTCUSDT five-minute bar [D-5m,D); signal close C is its close
features.reference_window: the 288 exact five-minute bars immediately preceding the signal bar, [D-24h-5m,D-5m)
features.reference_high_low: U=max(high) and L=min(low) over the 288 reference bars, finite positive
features.eligible_state: +1 iff C>U, -1 iff C<L, otherwise 0; inequalities are strict
features.onset: current valid state nonzero and prior valid anchor state is not the same side; invalid anchors preserve prior valid state
features.confirmation: block H+6 and every price input are complete before entry
features.source_valid: contiguous canonical chain and exact coherent five-minute grid with five unique one-minute rows per bar, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.one_anchor_stale_escape: primary valid-anchor state and side shifted one anchor before onset
definitions.same_clock_forced_long: same accepted primary clock with side forced long

bars.aggregation: exact five unique coherent one-minute rows per five-minute bar

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block predicate, threshold, confirmation, embargo, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
